# Volatility Update and Current Trades

Report 012 | Published 2020-03-05 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2020-3-5/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/012.json)

Small, staged put sales during severe volatility.

The staged-risk approach and CNQ survival analysis were useful. Five-year investment claims are now mature and require actual shareholder data. Repeated certainty about early option assignment remains technically incorrect, and annualized premium figures should not be confused with guaranteed returns.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

## Claims

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

Initial Q1 real GDP estimate was -4.8% annualized. BEA linked the decline partly to pandemic responses, with lower services and travel exports, while warning the complete COVID effect could not be isolated.

### 012-C02

**Weak operators may fail despite industry survival**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |

| Author modality | likely |
| Asset or variable | Travel restaurants and energy |

Issuer and IMF evidence show severe financing distress and energy bankruptcies. The distinction between surviving demand and surviving shareholders is sound; it does not establish each selected firm's safety.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [United States 2020 Article IV staff report](https://home.treasury.gov/system/files/206/1USAEA2020001.pdf) | IMF | 2020-07-17 | Verified in the audit

The report described energy bankruptcies at a decade high, weak shale economics and refinancing stress following the oil-price shock. This verifies distress, not a counterfactual without the pandemic.

- [Preliminary first-quarter fiscal 2020 results](https://investors.thecheesecakefactory.com/news-and-events/news-releases/news-release-details/2020/The-Cheesecake-Factory-Reports-Preliminary-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2020/default.aspx) | The Cheesecake Factory | 2020-05-05 | Verified in the audit

Q1 comparable sales fell 12.9%. Company suspended dividends, buybacks and new-unit development; obtained $200 million convertible preferred financing and covenant relief.

- [Fiscal 2020 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1125259/000081509721000027/ccl-20201130.htm) | Carnival / SEC | 2021-01-26 | Verified in the audit

FY 2020 net loss was $10.236 billion, versus $2.990 billion profit in 2019. Weighted average shares rose from 690 million to 775 million. Dividend stopped after first quarter; financing restricted future payments.

Higher implied volatility increases a put's theoretical value holding other inputs fixed. Rich nominal premiums are not necessarily cheap risk: implied-versus-realized volatility and crash losses determine attractiveness.

### 012-C06

**Cash-secured puts reduce downside and cap upside**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Same capital comparison; puts remain fully cash secured |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | Options versus shares |
| Source blocks | 23 |
| Thesis family | cash-secured-put-risk |

For the same expiry and an out-of-the-money strike, cash plus a short put has lower maximum loss than immediate stock ownership at the higher spot price; premium caps the upside. This is payoff arithmetic, not assurance of attractive realized risk-adjusted returns.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Payoff identity excluding fees, tax and cash yield.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Options assignment FAQ](https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/options-assignment) | Options Industry Council / OCC | Verified in the audit

American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

### 012-C08

**Below-strike trading necessarily assigns puts**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Before July/June 2020 expirations |
| Conditions | Stock falls below strike |

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Options assignment FAQ](https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/options-assignment) | Options Industry Council / OCC | Verified in the audit

American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

### 012-C13

**Target CAKE entry should work over five years**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | approximately five years (to March 2025) |
| Conditions | Hypothetical entry at stated target and holding approximately five years |
| Author modality | high probability |
| Asset or variable | CAKE |
| Source blocks | 43 |
| Thesis family | cheesecake-five-year-entry |

The conditional five-year recovery direction was supported: CAKE closed March 5, 2025 at $49.93, above the stated $23.50 net put-entry basis and also above the next-session $31.44 close. The next-session vendor dividend-adjusted sensitivity gained 73.67% (11.68% annualized), below SPY's 111.42%. This establishes a profitable hypothetical long holding, not the actual option trade or market outperformance. It also does not erase the 2020 financing stress.

**Direction:** Positive five-year investment direction supported; benchmark lagged.

**Timing:** Original approximate five-year horizon elapsed March 2025.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Actual execution and assignment are still needed to calculate the proposed put strategy P&L.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [CAKE daily historical prices and corporate actions](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CAKE/history/) | Yahoo Finance, retrieved by coordinator | Verified in the audit

No stock splits in downloaded interval. March 6, 2020 close $31.44; March 5, 2025 close $49.93. Adjusted proxy over those dates +73.67%.

- [SPY daily historical prices and corporate actions](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SPY/history/) | Yahoo Finance, retrieved by coordinator | Verified in the audit

Same five-year proxy +111.42%; comparator supplied by evaluator, not promised by this specific claim.

### 012-C14

**Target CNQ entry should work over five years**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | approximately five years (to March 2025) |
| Conditions | Hypothetical stated entry and approximately five-year holding |
| Author modality | high probability |
| Asset or variable | CNQ |
| Source blocks | 43 |
| Thesis family | cnq-five-year-entry |

CNQ closed March 5, 2025 at $27.43 after the issuer-confirmed 2024 2-for-1 split, versus the stated $20.70 original net basis equivalent to $10.35 after that split. This large price gain plus positive distributions supports the narrow five-year recovery thesis. Exact vendor total returns are withheld: its raw file labels an August 2022 special-cash-dividend adjustment as a 1021:1000 split, requiring reconciliation. Actual option execution is not established.

**Direction:** Strong positive five-year direction; exact total return not asserted.

**Timing:** Original approximate five-year horizon elapsed March 2025.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Next test:** Reconcile special-distribution adjustment and actual assignment before reporting precise strategy return.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [CNQ daily historical prices and corporate actions](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CNQ/history/) | Yahoo Finance, retrieved by coordinator | Verified in the audit

March 5, 2025 NYSE close $27.43. Raw events contain a 2:1 June 2024 split and a 1021:1000 August 2022 adjustment.

- [Stock split history](https://www.cnrl.com/investors/stock-split-history/) | Canadian Natural Resources | Verified in the audit

Issuer confirms 2-for-1 split with NYSE post-split trading June 11, 2024; no 2022 stock split listed.

- [Special cash dividend announcement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1017413/000101741322000049/a08042022specialdividend.htm) | Canadian Natural Resources / SEC | 2022-08-04 | Verified in the audit

Company declared C$1.50 special cash dividend payable August 31, 2022, to holders of record August 23.

## Framework lessons

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Some claims use coordinator-downloaded Yahoo adjusted-close proxies with explicit dates; these are not audited portfolio P&L. Unverified outcomes remain unscored. Original-vintage macro backtests were not performed.
